notices.html: Heat advisory Friday and Saturday: heat index near 100 to 105°F is expected, with a chance of afternoon storms Saturday. Plan outdoor picking and festivals for the morning, bring extra water, and keep an indoor backup for Saturday afternoon.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: blackberries are pick-your-own (picking began Aug 4), along with green beans, peppers and tomatoes. Still no peaches this year, the spring freeze wiped out the stone fruit. Store and donuts open 9 to 6, no pets; call 609-924-2310 to confirm the day's picking.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: blackberries are pick-your-own at the South Brunswick fields ($3 field admission plus a container fee); blueberries have wrapped for the season. Call 732-329-8656 for a crop update. Farm market and donuts open daily.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed 2026 update found online for this small, diversified farm. Early August usually brings blackberries, nectarines, corn and tomatoes, though no peaches this year after the spring freeze. Call 609-448-0629 for the day's pick, open 9 to 6, Sundays 2 to 6, arrive by 5:15pm to enter the fields.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: blackberries are newly added for 2026 alongside the tail end of blueberry season. Hayrides, animals and soft-serve stay open. Call the Pick Your Own Hotline 609-654-5894 to confirm what's ready before you go.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: the spring freeze wiped out cherries, peaches, nectarines and apples this year, so no stone-fruit or apple picking is expected all season. Bakery and store stay open; call 732-462-0756 to confirm what's on hand.

events.title: Middlesex County Fair
events.time: 11am to 11pm Sat, 11am to 10pm Sun, closing-night fireworks Sunday
events.desc: Carnival rides, live entertainment and 4-H exhibits all weekend, capped by fireworks on the fair's final night Sunday.

events.title: New Brunswick Heart Festival
events.desc: A free afternoon of live music and dance downtown, with free kids' dance classes, face painting and craft activities.

events.title: Disney's Aladdin KIDS
events.desc: A high-energy 40-minute kid-cast musical version of Aladdin, a good indoor backup if Saturday's storms roll through.
